name: Get user info
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current user's identifier and their access rights to custom objects and contact attributes. Use a specific object‑related action (e.g., creating or listing custom objects) instead if you need to perform those operations.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the authenticated account.

has_custom_objects_access.description: Indicates whether the user can access custom objects.

has_contact_attributes_access.description: Indicates whether the user can access contact attributes.
